authorship.creator: GitHub Copilot, original static pixel-grid drawing commissioned for Shadow Castle
authorship.method: Individually authored editable SVG masters with deliberate integer-grid silhouettes, stepped contours and material shading. Offline Godot SVG rasterization, palette quantization, then nearest-neighbor integer enlargement.
authorship.source_art_reuse: None. No scene props, inventory crops, downloaded icons, source artwork or third-party art were used.
authorship.rights: Original project contribution; no third-party attribution or licensing obligation introduced. No repository-wide license grant is invented here.

technical_frame.alpha: Binary 0/255; transparent outside the stepped plate silhouette, opaque illustration field
technical_frame.view: Orthographic conceptual diagram, not a world prop; lit material rims from upper left
technical_frame.display: 192x256 exact native pixels, centered in KnowledgeArtwork; nearest filtering; no crop or fractional resize
technical_frame.text: No rendered text, labels, numbers or functional UI copy. SVG title elements are non-rendered source metadata.

visual_system.palette_roles: Navy/violet field and ink; brass stepped keyline and separators; parchment lit surfaces; coral heat/oxygen/red light; jade leaf/green light; icy cyan water/current; sapphire blue light and a violet spectral endpoint.
visual_system.shape_language: Cut-corner plates, one-pixel brass inlay, confident stepped silhouettes, two-to-four shade clusters, localized glints rather than noise.
visual_system.approved_seed: chemical_physical.svg: split comparison diagram; inspected in the five-plate native-scale contact sheet.
visual_system.iteration: Enlarged the burning sheet's exposed parchment silhouette; corrected current arrows to conventional + to - flow; made additive blue explicitly sapphire rather than violet; replaced an ambiguous equal sign between timing processes with a comparison connector. Kept one integer grid and corrected contact-sheet alpha compositing.

assets.meaning: Folded paper burns to ash above; faceted ice and liquid water are joined by opposing reversible arrows below. Burning does not reverse by cooling.
A closed knife-switch contact, battery terminals and a glowing filament share one complete wire loop. Arrowheads denote conventional current outside the battery, from positive to negative.
Sunlight, a water drop and an oxygen-carbon-oxygen molecule enter a veined leaf/root system; paired oxygen and sugar crystals leave. Molecules are schematic, not a balanced molecular equation.
A clock dial branches to falling sand and a partly consumed candle over a shared comparison rail. These are independent estimates, not perfectly interchangeable calibrated timers.

Red, green and blue light overlap to yellow, cyan and magenta, with a pale white triple overlap. A separated lower diagram shows white light dispersing through glass; it does not imply a prism combines RGB light.

rebuild: Set isolated HOME and KNOWLEDGE_ART_EVIDENCE to the session .godot/knowledge-art-* directory, then run Godot --headless --path MAIN --script res://assets/ui/knowledge_plates/rasterize_plates.gd. This also rebuilds paired shoe prints from their separate SVG masters.

validation.approval: Approved after native contact-sheet review and actual MAIN project 1024x768 dossier captures in EN/ZH. Automated dimensions, palette, binary alpha, pixel clusters, exact topic selection, filing and review passed in MAIN and SESSION. All seven original raster assets replace no pre-existing source files.
